text:
Elaine: Quick ask — we need standardized inputs from HW partners for cost model by EOD Fri. Specifically: reserved commit windows, min/max qty, spot eviction rates (p95), typical lead times for adding reserved capacity, SKU mapping to our instance SKU, and any volume discounts.
Mike: Can someone share the CSV template? I'll ping partners.
Samir: I'll add columns for 'effective_util_pct' and 'spot_preemption_prob' — we can compute blended hourly cost = reserved_price*(commit_util) + spot_price*(1-commit_util)*(1+preemption_surcharge).
Elaine: yes pls use simple column set. minimal columns: partner_sku, partner_region, reserved_term_months, reserved_qty, reserved_price_usd_per_hour, spot_price_usd_per_hour, spot_p95_eviction_pct, lead_time_days, volume_discount_pct, billing_cadence, reserved_flex_type, notes
Mike: @Samir can you paste formula? easier if partners can paste numbers.
Samir: Formula pasted:
```
# blended_hourly_cost = reserved_price_usd_per_hour * commit_util + spot_price_usd_per_hour * (1 - commit_util) * (1 + spot_p99_eviction_rate)
# commit_util = reserved_qty / total_projected_demand
```
Hana: Partner question — do you want sustained vs burstable reserved splits? Some partners only sell 24/7 reserved, others allow flexible.
Elaine: Put a 'reserved_flex_type' column with values {sustained, burstable, flexible} and a short description field.
VendorBot: uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/partner_inputs/1768642001_partner_template.csv
Mike: I'll send to Zenith & VoltCloud — anyone else?
Hana: Add CoreWeave, Nebula, AuroraCloud.
Samir: Also request historical eviction logs for last 90d (per-region) — even aggregated counts are fine.
Elaine: Good. Also ask partners for billing cadence (invoiced monthly vs upfront) and refund terms on scale-down.
Mike: I'll draft outreach msg — short and clear.
Mike: Draft:
```
Hi <partner>,
Can you fill the attached CSV with your current SKU-level pricing and availability signals? Need reserved term, quantity, spot price, p95 eviction, lead times. Please include billing cadence and any refund/scale-down terms. Deadline: Fri EOD.
Thanks,
Mike (Partnerships)
```
Samir: minor ask — include any scheduled maintenance blackout windows, they change capacity.
Elaine: noted. thx all. I'll compile tracker once responses in. :thumbsup:
